name: Clan Personalities
description: Living clans with personalities that talk AND fight. Five personas (Peaceful, Neutral, Altruistic, Aggressive, Player-Killing) drive world-chat drama written live by the pack's FPC brain: quarrels, taunts, threats, alliances and remembered grudges. When a feud boils over, the clans settle it in a real NPC-vs-NPC duel outside a town gate - fair level and gear matching, class roles (healers heal, mages cast), a gossiping crowd, gloating winners, and win/loss records with revenge that persist across restarts. And the clans answer YOU: accuse one of ganking, praise one, take a side or just say hello, and they reply in character, call out your lies and remember them. Requires the FPC brain. Duels and player accusations on by default (Phase2 / Phase3 = False to turn them off).
author: Wyr
